evals.prompt: re-optimize the per-token params for all the deployed momentum tokens — full grid, and for each trail % show me what beats the deployed config
evals.expected_output: History coverage checked (and built/topped up if needed), per-token costs measured, isolated N=1 jobs run for every OK/SHORT token, verdicts written, REPORT.md created with a Summary table and one table per trail rung per token, linked in chat; momentum_tokens.json untouched.
expectations: ensure_history.py ran (report or --build) before any grid job
measure_costs.py wrote <run>/costs.json and each job used its token's cost
every grid job run by run_sweeps.py used a one-entry tokens file and --max-n 1 (book_ab.py alone uses the live N)
no momentum-sim call ran without HISTORY_MAX_SNAPSHOTS (all went through the scripts)
REPORT.md exists and its per-token sections contain a table for every trail rung, each with the deployed-knobs row (★ at the deployed trail, dep@T elsewhere)
the chat reply links REPORT.md and shows the Summary table inline

evals.prompt: re-tune HYPE only. full grid scan, single slot, compare every trail to what's deployed and tell me if anything is worth changing
evals.expected_output: A single-token run (--tokens HYPE): TRUST block, trail overview, per-trail axis tables, a verdict with the pick rule applied (keep unless a robust ✓win row clears the gates), paste-ready params only for a change.
expectations: the run was restricted to HYPE (--tokens HYPE)
the TRUST block reports T1 incumbent PASS or explains a WARN
the verdict cites the window line ('P/K back windows positive, best window X%')
a 'change' verdict (if any) picks a row flagged ✓win and not worse-tail
no apply happened without the user's explicit confirmation

evals.prompt: I just added KMNO to momentum_tokens.json with guessed params. does it have enough history? if not fetch it, then sweep it and show me the report
evals.expected_output: Coverage reports KMNO's span; a missing/short series is fetched via ensure_history.py --build (pinned pool, sequential, no-splice); KMNO is swept (or declared SHORT/INSUFFICIENT with the reason) and REPORT.md presented.
expectations: KMNO's coverage status (OK / SHORT / INSUFFICIENT) is stated with its day count
if history was missing, a raw KMNO series was fetched with its pinned pool from momentum_tokens.json
the book was written as a new dated file, not by overwriting an existing history file
REPORT.md contains a KMNO section or a 'Not swept' entry explaining why
